text: Luaths Lurgann was an Irish heroine whose name means speedy foot. She was the fastest runner in Ireland. Luaths served as midwife at the birth of her nephew, the boy destined to become the hero Fionn mac Cumhaill. She gave him shelter and trained him in the martial arts in her forest home when he needed protection from those who envied him. Fionn was devoted to his aunt. Pursued by an enemy one day, he lifted her and ran to safety. He ran so fast that the wind tore the warrior woman apart, leaving only her thighbones. Fionn used them to scoop out a lake that still bears her name, Loch Lurgann.

okr.objective: Document the Irish heroine Luaths Lurgann and her tie to the hero Fionn.
